newsitem.title: JAPAN: OSE says mulls listing index futures, options.
newsitem.headline: OSE says mulls listing index futures, options.

text.p: The Osaka Securities Exchange (OSE) said on Tuesday it is considering listing futures and options on sector indices.
The OSE said it is planning to list futures and options on the high-technology, consumer and financial sector indices.

The sector index is the weighted average of market prices and contains 25 to 50 issues each. The high-tech index includes major electronics and precision instrument firms. The consumer index includes retailers and services while financials are banks, the exchange said.
The OSE did not provide a schedule for the listings.
